scope: Conditional paired-read rescue with an explicit mode disabling graph assembly and consensus. Baseline includes the preceding shared-group and conditional-length changes.

tests.native_mapping_only_check: Assembly and consensus functions raise if invoked; expansion40 and no new measured classification votes required; stronger existing lower bound must survive a conflicting rescue.

method: Serial fresh processes, identical input bytes; source order alternates when comparing versions. Wall time excludes imports. RSS is max(parent, largest child), not concurrent total. Synthetic expected alleles are specified independently of caller agreement. Preparation is excluded from timing. All outputs and disagreements are retained.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures only; matched server data remain inaccessible.
Rescue assumes a pure periodic array and a valid calibrated fragment component. Longer interrupted arrays can explain the same reads.
Overlap-derived calibration cannot exclude an unseen population of longer nonoverlapping fragments and never populates whole-library insert calibration.
Every rescue remains ESTIMATED with upper_unbounded=true, finite_length_support=false, no measured classification votes, and no reconstructed sequence.
Isolate paired-read rescue requires reciprocal informative junction molecules; metagenome mode does not use this rescue.
Candidate, profile-work and likelihood-cell caps fail closed. Unsupported multi-error/indel patterns, conflicting identities, competing loci and missing calibration can prevent a rescue.

whole_library_calibration.limitation: The conditional model corrects modeled target selection only; library and background assumptions remain uncalibrated and paired-length genotypes remain estimates.

background_workload.recipe: Original challenge pairs plus50000 independent random180bp fragments;100bp mates;Q40;Random(41237). Generated preparation excluded from timing. Synthetic off-target throughput check, not a whole-genome accuracy benchmark.
